photos.c: 21st JUNE 1952. Five months after her accession to the throne HER MAJESTY QUEEN ELIZABETH II visits the A.A.A. Championships at the White City. On the left is A.A. Harley and to the right The Marquess of Exeter.

Left: 21st June 1952. Five months after her accession to the throne Her Majest Queen Elizabeth II visits the A.A.A. Championships at White City. On the left is Belgrave's President A.A. Harley and on the right is A.A.A. President The Marquess of Exeter. Photographer unknown.
